title: kbgit.py publish refuses a commit whose message or trailers hold an email address other than a noreply or placeholder one
goal: kbgit.py publish (and its --dry-run) refuses, exit 1, a commit of the range whose message or trailers hold an email address of the leak scan's shape, unless its local part is noreply or no-reply or its domain is a placeholder the leak scan allows, naming the commit and the field but never printing the address; a Co-Authored-By line with a noreply address still publishes

notes: Premise (2026-10-19): a planted publish --dry-run of a commit whose message holds a non-placeholder address publishes (exit 0). Fires-now check (2026-10-19): refs/kb/published..origin/main holds 10651 commits; their messages hold 7968 address hits of kbcommon.leak_hits, every one the noreply address of Anthropic in Co-Authored-By (EMAIL_OK allows noreply hosts, not a noreply local part, so this note cannot spell it), none other; so the refusal, with noreply local parts allowed, refuses nothing on today's range. Test policy (D-6kei5o2z, D-2tq4fhgs): a publish gate is critical, so the item may add one planted case (an address in a commit message is refused) inside the existing test_publish_refuses_a_leak_in_any_commit_of_the_range, no new test function or file; never touch _tools/tests_ceiling.json. Author and committer emails are not this item's: the open gate on the author-email item decides them.
